title: Massive jackpots in America, Australia and Europe available now!
heading: Weekend Lottery Roundup
description: Find amazing opportunities to explore for our lottery spend this week. American jackpots are massive. Superdraws in Australia and Europe have arrived. The time to dream big is now.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
Luck be in the air. We have amazing opportunities to explore for our lottery spend this week. American Jackpots are sky high. The long-awaited Euromillions Superdraw and Australian Superdraw have arrived. Lotto Express is bursting with jackpot excitement.

American Powerball and Mega Mega Millions keep climbing

There’s no time to lose with both major American lotteries featuring big number jackpots eclipsing half a billion dollars.

Will this be the week the American Mega Millions jackpot gets taken down? Get your plays in quickly to play for a $687 Million jackpot this Friday night.

Saturday’s American Powerball jackpot is ready for a new jackpot winner at any moment and it could be you. Play for the $521 million American Powerball jackpot this Saturday.

The American Dream is alive and well at LottoExpress.com!

Australian Superdraw has arrived

The Australia 6/45 draw on March 16 arrives with a guaranteed Jackpot of $20 Million. Lottery enthusiasts around the world are eagerly anticipating this not-to-be-missed event.

Australian Superdraws are rare occurrences, adding to the excitement and anticipation, where a special SUPER-SIZED minimum jackpot is guaranteed.

Unlike regular draws, the pre-scheduled Australian Superdraw offers a minimum guaranteed jackpot regardless of whether there was a carryover from the preceding draw.

Don’t miss out on this fantastic opportunity.

Euromillions Superdraw Super Jackpot

Tickets for the pre-announced March 15 Euromillions Superdraw are now available at Lotto Express. The jackpot for this draw will be €130 million, regardless of whether the previous draw carries over or not. Don’t miss out on your chance to get in on the action and potentially secure a significant windfall.

Play for the Euromillions Superdraw jackpot now and join the excitement!

Good Luck everybody on your weekend plays.
